issues.explanation: New production code ships without any Pest/PHPUnit test, violating the TDD convention that requires a test for every feature.
Daily archive retention wiring to LOG_DAILY_DAYS is not shown in the diff, so the 14-day contract detail must be treated as missing.
Text building and truncation happen before the try block, so a formatting error would escape and violate the never-throw guarantee.
Sensitive-key and Bearer checks are duplicated between formatValue and redactArray instead of sharing one helper.
New docs file has no trailing newline.

conventions.evidence: docs/ops/logging.md:1-54, CHANGELOG.md:34 and .env.example cover docs-sync; but no test file in diff violates conventions.md TDD 'No production code without a test'

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:53 send, :77 buildText, :88 formatValue, :115 isSensitiveKey, :128 redactArray are small with clear names; no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:55-59 no-op, :62 mb_substr 1800, :65 timeout(3) post content, :115-126 sensitive keys, :94 Bearer redact, :98-102 nested JSON, :68-73 error logs scrubbed; audit config/logging.php:174-180 and stack daily config/logging.php:166 plus .env.example/phpunit.xml meet lanes; daily LOG_DAILY_DAYS wiring not in diff and build outside try

scope.evidence: .env.example, CHANGELOG.md, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/logging.md, phpunit.xml all serve the Discord/logging task; no unrelated refactor

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:90-96 and :133-143 redact sensitive keys and Bearer values, :68 Log::error status only, :71-73 str_replace URL with [redacted]; no secrets in logs

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:51-75 lean reuse of config/Http/Log; minor duplication of redaction logic in formatValue vs redactArray

tests.evidence: change.diff lists 7 files, none under tests/ or *Test.php; no coverage for notifier, truncation, redaction, soft-fail or audit channel

review.summary: Adds DiscordOpsAlert with truncation, redaction and soft-fail plus audit/daily stack config, docs and env keys. Correct main path but missing tests, unproven daily retention wiring, and formatting outside the never-throw block, so it needs changes before merging.
